form-labels.$description: Labels move beside the field at or above this CONTAINER width. Design file 20: 'a 104px label column plus a usable field needs that much. Below it, labels go on top.' Container, not viewport — a form in a 400px drawer stacks its labels on a 2560px monitor.

form-columns.$description: A form pairs its fields into two columns at or above this container width. Design file 20: 'otherwise the pairs are too narrow to hold a date beside a duration.'
